# VRCGT — Generated Files Cleanup

**Date:** 2026-05-11  
**Scope:** Build artifacts, compiler output, npm cache — working-tree only  
**No source files were modified or deleted.**

---

## 1. Pre-Cleanup Audit

All artifact directories existed on disk but **none were tracked in git** (verified with `git ls-files`). The cleanup was a working-tree-only operation — no commits or index changes were needed.

A `VRCGT.Server` process was running and had locked 13 DLLs in `src/VRCGT.Server/bin/`. It was stopped before that directory could be removed.

---

## 3. Files / Directories NOT Removed

| Path | Reason kept |
|---|---|
| `src/VRCGT.Server/wwwroot/` (3 files) | Generated by `npm run build`, but intentionally present for clone-and-run convenience. See GITIGNORE_AUDIT.md §7 for advisory. |
| `src/VRCGT.Infrastructure/Migrations/` | EF Core migrations — **source files**, not artifacts. Never delete. |
| `src/VRCGT.Web/package-lock.json` | Per-task rule: do not remove package lock files |
| All `*.cs`, `*.xaml`, `*.csproj` source | Per-task rule: do not remove source files |
| All `*.md`, docs | Per-task rule: do not remove docs |

## 7. How to Regenerate Removed Files

```bash
# All .NET build output (bin/ + obj/)
dotnet build VRCGroupTools.sln /p:SkipWebFrontend=true

# npm dependencies
cd src/VRCGT.Web
npm ci

# artifacts/ (v2 cross-platform publish)
.\scripts\build.ps1           # all 4 RIDs: win-x64, linux-x64, osx-x64, osx-arm64
.\scripts\build.ps1 -Rids win-x64  # Windows only
```
